name: pf-skills
description: Curated Claude Code skill catalog: shared building blocks, two idea→ship lanes (engineering, one-shot), design, review, and productivity skills. Projects opt in per plugin.

plugins.name: building
plugins.description: Shared foundation both lanes start from: grilling interviews, prototyping, handoffs, knowledge capture, zoom-out context. Co-install with engineering or one-shot.

plugins.name: one-shot
plugins.description: End-to-end plan→ship orchestration with three autonomy modes (hitl/grill/auto), plus its PRD lane (write-a-prd → prd-to-issues → issue-worker/issue-swarm). Review cascade (code-review → code-fix), council-of-agents planning, create-pr + create-commit hygiene, and the aoe stacked-PR pipeline over tagged GitHub issues (aoe-orchestrate-plan: resident orchestrator hub, parallel lanes, switchable hitl/afk).

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design workflow: map the IA, define the design system, then build a navigable lo-fi wireframe.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Humanize AI-drafted copy: detect and fix the documented signs of AI writing.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering lane (mostly vendored from mattpocock/skills): the ask-the-flow router, TDD, diagnosing bugs, domain modelling, codebase design, spec/ticket flows, triage, research, code review, improve-codebase-architecture, wayfinder multi-session planning, session retrospectives, wizard generation.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's productivity skills: teaching, questionnaires, re-pitching unclear messages, writing for agents.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Per-repo configuration wizard for the pf-skills plugins: /setup-pf-skills scaffolds the docs/agents/ files and Agent-skills block that building, engineering, and one-shot read. Run once per repo.

plugins.name: reviewing
plugins.description: Owned review skills: ADR decay sweeps, PRD drift checks, and multi-phase branch review.
